extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Natural and man-made changes — natural features: rivers, hills, trees, ponds, lakes, rocks (exist without humans). Man-made features: roads, buildings, dams, bridges, parks, schools (built by people). Locality changes over time — natural changes (river changes course, tree grows) and man-made changes (fields to housing, forests cleared for roads). (2) Positive and negative effects — positive: better transport (roads, bridges), shelter (houses), water storage (dams), recreation (parks). Negative: loss of trees, animals lose homes, ponds filled, less land for crops, area gets hotter. (3) Need for shelter — shelter protects from rain, heat, cold, wild animals. Types: kutcha house (temporary — mud, bamboo, thatch), pucca house (permanent — bricks, cement, steel), apartment (many homes in one building), stilt house (raised on poles for flood safety). (4) Communication — postal letter (slow, paper), telephone/mobile (fast, voice), email/internet (fastest, digital), SMS/text message. Communication connects people across distances. (5) Transport — 4 modes: road (bus, car, cycle, truck — flexible, reaches remote villages), rail (train — long distance, many passengers, cheaper than air), water (ship, boat — across rivers and seas, slow but cheap for heavy goods), air (aeroplane — fastest, most expensive, long distances). Misconceptions: 'all man-made changes are bad' (man-made changes have BOTH positive and negative effects — roads give better transport but cutting forests destroys animal homes), 'a kutcha house and a pucca house are the same' (kutcha houses are TEMPORARY made of mud and thatch, pucca houses are PERMANENT made of bricks and cement — they are different), 'the post office is the fastest way to communicate' (postal letters are the SLOWEST — telephone, mobile, and email are much faster), 'rail transport is faster than air transport' (air transport by aeroplane is the FASTEST mode — rail is cheaper but slower than air), 'water transport is the fastest' (water transport by ship is the SLOWEST for passengers — it is used because it is cheap for heavy goods, not because it is fast). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function ChangesTransportGame), NOT export default. Export interface ChangesTransportGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
